nodes.label: Clean Marketplace Redesign (white + coral accent, Inter only)
nodes.rationale: The owner judged the editorial-pastel look unprofessional; move to an Airbnb/Idealista-style clean marketplace: dominant white, one coral accent, modern sans (Inter only), photos as protagonists, 3-column card grid, Airbnb-style detail with 2x2+4 gallery and sticky contact column, search-first hero.
